title: Ox Passion Blue Sour Razz Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Blue Sour Razz delivers an intense fusion of tart Blue Raspberry with a sharp, citrusy sour edge. The vibrant berry flavour bursts onto the palate with a lively tang, followed by a mouth-watering sour twist that lingers on the exhale, striking the perfect balance between sweet and sharp. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring a smooth throat hit with bold, well-defined flavour. Ideal for pod vape kits and starter devices, it provides rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
